# Health It

This folder groups digital health tools and pharmaceutical products utilized in the management and treatment of Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) within the Danish healthcare system. It documents the Constant – Care application, a digital platform for remote patient monitoring and calprotectin testing at Nordsjællands Hospital, as well as five modern IBD therapies—filgotinib, mirikizumab, ozanimod, risankizumab, and upadacitinib. These pharmaceutical entries were assigned new administrative codes in the Danish National Patient Registry in 2024 to facilitate precise national quality tracking and outcome evaluation.

## Pages

- [[constant-care|Constant – Care]] — A digital patient application used at Nordsjællands Hospital for the remote monitoring of IBD patients and point-of-care calprotectin testing.
- [[filgotinib]] — A new IBD treatment preparation that received a new administrative code in the Danish National Patient Registry in 2024 to enable national quality tracking.
- [[mirikizumab]] — An IBD biologic therapy assigned a new registry code in 2024 to allow its inclusion in national fecal calprotectin measurement indicators.
- [[ozanimod]] — A pharmaceutical drug for IBD that was integrated into the national patient registry with a new treatment code in 2024 for improved clinical tracking.
- [[risankizumab]] — A modern IBD treatment that received new administrative coding in 2024 to support the evaluation of treatment outcomes and quality indicators.
- [[upadacitinib]] — A JAK inhibitor for IBD that was added to the national patient registry in 2024 to monitor medical therapy quality metrics across Danish regions.
